subject.title: fix(agents): stop tool discovery from breaking prompt caches

question: Should existing Tool Search directory-mode users retain prompt-selected direct schemas, or should cache stability intentionally replace that documented behavior for every existing configuration?
rationale: The patch changes the observable semantics of a persisted, documented tool-search mode without a migration or explicit user selection; tests can establish deterministic ordering but cannot choose the product compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve existing directory semantics
options.body: Keep prompt-selected direct schemas for existing directory-mode configurations and isolate cache-stable deferred-only behavior behind an explicitly approved compatible path.

options.title: Accept the behavior change
options.body: Approve deferred-only directory mode as an intentional upgrade change, document the added discovery turn and provide fresh-install and upgrade evidence.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Hold this broad cache change until maintainers choose a stable directory-mode contract that does not silently alter existing user workflows.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing directory semantics
recommendation.body: Keep prompt-selected direct schemas for existing directory-mode configurations and isolate cache-stable deferred-only behavior behind an explicitly approved compatible path.

likelyOwner.reason: The maintainer-owned branch and implementation context make steipete the best available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
